llc-meeting-minutes-template.0: LLC owners search for an LLC meeting minutes template for 2 reasons. Either a bank, lender or accountant asked for minutes, or they read that keeping them helps protect their personal liability. Both justify getting the basics right.
llc-meeting-minutes-template.22: Usually the person who chaired the meeting and the person who recorded the minutes sign. Single-member LLC? The sole member signs a written consent. Use a printed name, signature and date for each signer, and file the signed copy alongside the operating agreement and other company records.
